title: The nested-backend branch in the drift guard is inert against the committed all…
body: The nested-backend branch in the drift guard is inert against the committed all-claude project.toml (backend is 'claude' for every phase, so `nested` is always undefined). This is intentional forward-correctness per the story, and the nested [models.codex] resolution itself is covered adversarially at lines 221-287, so it is not blocking; noting only that the added branch has no live case in this describe block today.
